What's your return and refund policy?

Sent · Just now

Dermalogica's Virtual Assistant · AI

Dermalogica's Virtual Assistant · AI says:

Our policy is to gladly accept returns for any Dermalogica.com purchase for any reason. You must initiate the return within 30 days of your order date. Only new or gently used items in original packaging are eligible; damaged, nearly empty, tampered items, partial kits, free samples, gift-with-purchase, and rewards items are final sale and non-refundable.

How returns work

Use our online returns center to generate a prepaid UPS return label.
Repackage items, include the packing slip, affix the label, and drop off at UPS.
Once we receive your package at our warehouse, we’ll process your refund or replacement.
Only returns traceable to our warehouse using our label are eligible for credit.

Shipping and fees

Within 30 days, you won’t pay return shipping, handling, or restocking fees for Dermalogica.com orders.

Payments and third-party services

For orders placed with Afterpay or Klarna, the same Dermalogica return policy applies; please also refer to each provider’s own return/refund policy on their website.

Cancellations and points

Orders already processed generally cannot be canceled or modified. If you no longer want your order, you can return it through our online return center for a full refund of all returned items once received.
Any returned or canceled order will reverse or decrease rewards points earned from that purchase and may affect your tier status.
